notes: Assam runs its rounds on the 2021 Rules (amended in 2023 and 2024) and short DME notices; the number of rounds follows the Government of India's schedule. The Rules are scanned gazette pages: the lines from them are our reading, with the page.

r1.title: Round 1
chips: AIQ seat? Bring its resignation letter
who: Candidates who meet the NEET-PG 2025 cut-off and are on the State provisional merit list.
Anyone holding an All India Quota seat must bring that college's resignation or surrender acceptance letter to be admitted.
opts: Leave to upgrade, or surrender in time

Leaving the college to upgrade, within the time set for that counselling session, or surrendering the seat before the last date of admission, gets back 90% of the fees deposited at admission; nothing after the last date.
gaps: the counselling and admission fee amounts: the Rules say the DME notifies them, and the 2025-26 notices we read don't state them.

r2.title: Round 2
chips: Change college, or get a seat
who: Round 1 participants needn't register again; they can fill choices for a fresh allotment or a change of college.
Anyone holding an All India Quota seat must bring that college's resignation or surrender acceptance letter to be admitted.
opts: Report to the new college with the previous college's receipt for the certificates you lodged there.
Leaving your seat to upgrade, within the time set for that counselling session, gets back 90% of the fees deposited at admission.

r3.title: Round 3
who: The round was postponed and rerun on MCC's new schedule; candidates eligible under the revised NEET-PG cut-off published by NBE could register, and earlier registrants needn't register again and could choose again for a fresh allotment or a change of college.
opts: Report to the new college with the previous college's receipt for the certificates you lodged there.

Candidates who have been re-allotted seats at the time of 3rd counselling shall have to report to the newly allotted College with the acknowledgement receipts/documentary proof of submitting the certificates/testimonials etc. issued by the previous Principals
on 18th to 19th February, 2026 for admission, failing which his/her allotment shall be cancelled.
To be admitted, bring the resignation or surrender acceptance letter from your All India Quota college.
Candidates who have already taken admission under 50% All India Quota must produce a copy of resignation/ surrender acceptance letter from the respective College/ Institutes for admission.

stray.title: Stray round
who: Anyone who joined an AIQ or State quota seat up to Round 3 can't take part.
opts: Joined a seat up to Round 3
You can't take part in this or any later State round.
It is to be noted that candidates who joined upto round 3 of AIQ or State Quota seats shall not be eligible to participate in the further rounds for State Quota seat counselling.
A seat not taken up within the time fixed by the Government of India is forfeited.
gaps: a penalty for not joining a stray-round seat, beyond losing it.

after.title: Leaving the course
opts: Surrender after the last date of admission
Rs 10,00,000 for a degree seat (Rs 5,00,000 for a diploma), plus the stipend drawn.

After the course, serve the Government of Assam, or an agency the Department notifies, for 2 years, or pay Rs 20 lakh (degree) or Rs 15 lakh (diploma); taking the money instead of service is the Department's call, only in compelling circumstances. The Government may release you earlier. Not for candidates in regular Assam government service or on N.E.C. quota seats. State Health Service quota candidates bind themselves for at least 10 years, or pay Rs 25 lakh plus the salary/stipend drawn.
amend24: Rule 9(i), p.2-3; rules: Rule 8(v), p.6; Rule 9(iii), p.7
No refund after the last date
Fees aren't refunded after the last date of admission.
gaps: the 2025-26 last date of admission that starts the penalty: the notices we read don't give it.

reg: Counselling fee: set by DME notice; the amount isn't in the 2025-26 notices we read.
lose: 10% of the fees deposited at admission, if you leave to upgrade in time or surrender before the last date of admission.
back: 90% of the fees deposited at admission in those cases; nothing after the last date of admission.
leave: Rs 10,00,000 (degree) or Rs 5,00,000 (diploma) + stipend after the last date of admission; a 2-year service bond of Rs 20 lakh (degree) or Rs 15 lakh (diploma).
